run_release_extension_linux.py.text:
"""Run DISC08 on an exact local candidate in an isolated Linux clone."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, json, os, re, subprocess, sys, time

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('candidate')
args = parser.parse_args()
assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', args.candidate)
work = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source = work / 'se_harness'
destination = Path('/tmp') / ('se-harness-release-extension-' + args.candidate[:12])
assert not destination.exists()
out = work / 'plugin-probe-control/se-harness-release-discovery-repair/linux'
env = os.environ.copy()
env.pop('PYTHONPATH', None)
env.pop('PYTHONHOME', None)
env.update(GIT_CONFIG_COUNT='3', GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0='safe.directory', GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=str(source),
           GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1='core.autocrlf', GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1='false',
           GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2='core.longpaths', GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2='true')
for label, command, cwd in (
    ('clone', ['git', 'clone', '--no-hardlinks', '--no-checkout', str(source), str(destination)], work),
    ('checkout', ['git', 'checkout', '--detach', args.candidate], destination),
    ('origin', ['git', 'remote', 'set-url', 'origin', 'https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness.git'], destination),
    ('case', [sys.executable, '-m', 'unittest', 'tests.test_artifact_authoring.IdentifierAllocationTests.test_allocation_refuses_outside_a_checkout_and_an_explicit_id_on_any_ref', '-v'], destination),
    ('suite', [sys.executable, 'scripts/run_tests.py', '--workers', '4'], destination),
):
    target = out / ('extension-' + label + '.json')
    assert not target.exists()
    start = time.time()
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf8')
    data = dict(candidate=args.candidate, command=command, cwd=str(cwd), started_at_unix=start,
                elapsed_seconds=round(time.time()-start, 3), exit_code=result.returncode,
                stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)
    target.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf8', newline='\n')
    print(label, result.returncode, data['elapsed_seconds'], flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        print(result.stdout[-3000:], result.stderr[-3000:], flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)

"""Count actual Git tar entries without extracting or changing the repository."""
from pathlib import Path
import io, json, subprocess, sys, tarfile

repo = Path.cwd().resolve()
commit = sys.argv[1]
git = ['git', '-c', 'safe.directory=' + repo.as_posix(), '-c', 'core.longpaths=true', '-C', str(repo)]
assert subprocess.check_output(git + ['rev-parse', commit]).decode().strip() == commit
raw = subprocess.check_output(git + ['archive', '--format=tar', commit])
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw), mode='r:') as archive:
    members = archive.getmembers()
    result = {'candidate': commit, 'tar_members': len(members),
              'files': sum(m.isfile() for m in members), 'directories': sum(m.isdir() for m in members),
              'expanded_bytes': sum(m.size for m in members), 'limit': 10000}
assert result['tar_members'] <= result['limit']
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

"""Retain exact-head hosted observations and byte-preserving selected logs."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64, datetime, hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys

work = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
label = sys.argv[1]
out = work / 'plugin-probe-control/se-harness-release-discovery-repair/ci' / (label + '.json')
assert not out.exists()
commands = []
def gh(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['gh', *args], capture_output=True)
    assert result.returncode in ({0, 1, 8} if args[:2] == ('pr', 'checks') else {0}), result.stderr
    commands.append(dict(argv=['gh', *args], exit_code=result.returncode))
    return result.stdout
pull = json.loads(gh('pr', 'view', '452', '--repo', 'mmzen/se_harness', '--json',
                     'headRefOid,baseRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,state,url,isDraft'))
checks = json.loads(gh('pr', 'checks', '452', '--repo', 'mmzen/se_harness', '--json', 'name,state,link'))
assert all(row['state'] not in {'IN_PROGRESS', 'QUEUED', 'PENDING'} for row in checks), 'CI still running'
retained = {}
selected = {'validate', 'Candidate source evidence', 'Candidate package evidence',
            'Upgrade rehearsal (Linux)', 'Upgrade rehearsal (Windows)',
            'Rehearse the qualification of the release record / Qualify and replay (release-record)'}
for row in checks:
    if row['name'] not in selected:
        continue
    match = re.search(r'/actions/runs/(\d+)/job/(\d+)', row['link'])
    assert match, row
    run_id, job_id = match.groups()
    job = json.loads(gh('api', f'repos/mmzen/se_harness/actions/jobs/{job_id}'))
    assert job['head_sha'] == pull['headRefOid']
    raw = gh('api', '--allow-escape-sequences', f'repos/mmzen/se_harness/actions/jobs/{job_id}/logs')
    text = raw.decode('utf8', errors='replace')
    checkouts = re.findall(r'git log -1 --format=%H\r?\n[^\r\n]*?([a-f0-9]{40})(?:\r?\n)', text)
    retained[row['name']] = dict(job=job, log_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                                 log_base64=base64.b64encode(raw).decode(), initial_checkouts=checkouts)
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
value = dict(observed_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), pull=pull,
             checks=checks, jobs=retained, commands=commands,
             non_successful=[row for row in checks if row['state']!='SUCCESS'],
             authority='Read-only CI observation; no implementation-completion or assurance decision.')
out.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(head=pull['headRefOid'], checks=len(checks), retained_logs=len(retained),
                     non_successful=value['non_successful'], output=str(out))))

"""Retain the approved fixture correction and its observations in one bundle."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast, hashlib, json, subprocess

work = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = work / 'se-harness-release-discovery-repair'
control = work / 'plugin-probe-control' / repo.name
evidence = repo / 'docs/engineering/release-orchestration/evidence/WO-RLO-009'
baseline = 'fb6f60d5069706e8ae0ca69d1263285cbb904f45'
reviewed = 'a53f5663bb812aa0c91d9f01ad2d104311d20fc9'
candidate = 'cda9474c71a9f14b51d16a3f22ab6ecabff12e89'

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-c', 'safe.directory='+repo.as_posix(),
        '-c', 'core.longpaths=true', '-c', 'core.autocrlf=false', '-C', str(repo), *args])

def tree(commit):
    result = {}
    for entry in git('ls-tree', '-r', '-z', commit).split(b'\0'):
        if entry:
            metadata, path = entry.split(b'\t', 1)
            result[path.decode()] = metadata.decode().split()
    return result

assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == candidate
before, after = tree(baseline), tree(candidate)
historical = {p: v for p, v in before.items() if p.startswith('docs/engineering/')}
assert all(after.get(p) == v for p, v in historical.items())
test_path = 'tests/test_artifact_authoring.py'
old = git('show', reviewed+':'+test_path).decode()
new = git('show', candidate+':'+test_path).decode()
method = 'test_allocation_refuses_outside_a_checkout_and_an_explicit_id_on_any_ref'
old_method = next(n for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(old)) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == method)
new_method = next(n for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(new)) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == method)
old_segment = ast.get_source_segment(old, old_method)
new_segment = ast.get_source_segment(new, new_method)
expected = old_segment.replace('        import shutil\n\n', '', 1).replace(
    'shutil.rmtree(self.root / ".git")', '(self.root / ".git").rename(self.root / ".git-retained")', 1)
assert expected == new_segment
assert old.replace(old_segment, new_segment, 1) == new
assert (repo / test_path).read_bytes() == git('show', candidate+':'+test_path)

observations = {}
for folder in ('local', 'linux'):
    for path in sorted((control / folder).glob('extension-*.json')):
        value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf8'))
        assert value['exit_code'] == 0
        observations[f'{folder}/{path.name}'] = value
for name in ('extension-validate', 'extension-preflight', 'extension-final-doctor',
             'extension-final-validate', 'extension-final-preflight', 'extension-final-scope',
             'extension-handoff-evidence'):
    observations[name+'.json'] = json.loads((control / (name+'.json')).read_text(encoding='utf8'))
observations['ci/pre-extension-a53.json'] = json.loads((control / 'ci/pre-extension-a53.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
windows = observations['local/extension-suite-windows.json']
linux = observations['linux/extension-suite.json']
for result, skipped in ((windows, 23), (linux, 4)):
    output = result['stdout'] + result['stderr']
    assert 'Ran 1142 tests' in output and f'OK (skipped={skipped})' in output
scripts = {}
for name in ('run_release_extension_linux.py', 'run_release_discovery.py',
             'run_probe_evaluator_017.py', 'count_plugin_integration_archive.py',
             'retain_release_discovery_ci.py', 'retain_release_extension.py'):
    raw = (work / name).read_bytes()
    scripts[name] = dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), text=raw.decode())
bundle = dict(candidate=candidate, baseline=baseline, reviewed_extension=reviewed,
    approval_receipt_sha256=hashlib.sha256((evidence/'extension-approval.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    exact_fixture_diff=git('diff', reviewed, candidate, '--', test_path).decode(),
    preservation=dict(existing_engineering_paths=len(historical), all_blobs_and_modes_unchanged=True,
        named_fixture_only=True, every_assertion_unchanged=True,
        code_and_discovery_tests_unchanged_since_review=all(after[p] == tree(reviewed)[p] for p in (
            '.github/scripts/publish_dashboard.py', '.github/scripts/publish_release.py', 'tests/test_release_orchestration.py'))),
    platform_suites=dict(windows=dict(tests=1142, skips=23, passed=True),
                         linux=dict(tests=1142, skips=4, passed=True), no_new_skips=True),
    observations=observations, scripts=scripts,
    authority='Observations only. WO remains in_progress. No completion, VREC preparation, assurance or merge decision.')
target = evidence / 'extension-results.json'
assert not target.exists()
target.write_text(json.dumps(bundle, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(path=str(target), sha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), observations=len(observations))))
